body.objective: Students will be able to locate francophone regions.
successCriteria: I can locate major francophone regions on a map
I can describe some regional differences in French
I can explain cultural connections in the francophonie
body.hook: French is spoken on five continents, by more than 320 million people. A student in Moncton, one in Dakar and one in Port-au-Prince all speak French, but each would notice the others' accents and expressions right away.

vocabulary.definition: The community of countries and people who use French.
Acadia, the francophone region of Atlantic Canada.

study.title: La francophonie dans le monde
study.question: Where is French spoken, and how does it vary?
study.passage:
Francophone regions:
• Canada: Québec, Acadie (New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, PEI), francophone communities in Ontario, Manitoba and Alberta (for example Saint-Paul, Bonnyville and Edmonton's Bonnie Doon).
• Europe: France, Belgium, Switzerland, Luxembourg, Monaco.
• Africa: about half of the world's French speakers, for example Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Cameroon, Morocco (widely used).
• Caribbean and elsewhere: Haiti, Martinique, Guadeloupe, French Polynesia, Vanuatu.
Regional expressions (Québec vs France):
• Weekend: la fin de semaine (Québec) / le week-end (France)
• Car: le char (familiar, Québec) / la voiture
• To chat: jaser (Québec) / bavarder
• Shopping: magasiner (Québec) / faire du shopping (France)
• Breakfast, lunch, supper: déjeuner, dîner, souper (Québec) / petit-déjeuner, déjeuner, dîner (France)
Texte : Je m'appelle Awa. J'habite à Dakar, au Sénégal. À la maison, je parle wolof avec ma famille, mais à l'école, je parle français. Mon cousin habite à Montréal. Quand il dit « On va magasiner en fin de semaine », je ris ! Mais nous partageons la même langue et beaucoup de chansons.
Task: Label a world map with ten francophone countries or regions. Then match expressions to regions.
study.source: Original text written for this lesson; figures summarized from the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie.
